irregularities.finding: GEO-Pb v1 split-halo defect: src/gems85/geopb.py applied the two-sample across-line step difference Y(x+3n) - Y(x-3n) to det_elev_slope (band 19) and 1m LiDAR step_max (lidar band 3). Both are non-negative edge magnitudes that peak ON the fault trace (x=0). Differencing a positive impulse across +/-3 px produces ZERO on the fault trace (x=0) and two false shoulders at x = +/-3 px (+/-300 m, where the 300 m triangular kernel k(300 m) = 0), causing crest() NMS to place dots on the +/-300 m shoulders and collapsing geopb_crest AUC from 0.5884 to 0.5036.
irregularities.action_taken: Separated bulk STATE juxtaposition (16-strike whitened step across rtp, tmi, iso_grav_anom, depth_to_base_surf, cond_surf, TMI_up150, K/Th/U/ThK/UK/UTh, det_elev) from on-fault INTERFACE localization (LiDAR lappos_max/lapneg_max/step_max/ex_max/relief, det_elev_slope, -tc, iso_grav_anom_slope, tmi_hg evaluated at x=0) in src/gems85/next_gen.py, recovering post-crest AUC from 0.5036 to 0.5831.

irregularities.finding: Withheld-block negative contamination and 2D ribbon blob-clumping in scripts/run_supervised.py: (1) sampling negatives across the full footprint labeled unmasked withheld faults inside the 20 km withheld blocks as negatives, and including smooth regional fields (det_elev, depth_to_base, cond_surf, geod_*, ieq_*, deq_*) let the GBM identify and suppress the withheld blocks (OOF AUC 0.5475-0.5728); (2) running poisson_thin directly on smooth 2D probabilities packed dots in 2D across range-front ribbons (4-10 px off-fault) rather than along 1D fault centerlines.
irregularities.action_taken: Restricted the fold-proper GBM to translation-invariant local derivative/juxtaposition/scarp channels, sampled negatives only within visible-fault blocks, and applied 1-step Hessian-normal axial crest extraction (crest_1step). This lifted OOF withheld-AUC from 0.5728 to 0.6455 (4/4 folds) and 37,654-dot HOLDOUT-DTI from 0.06233 to 0.10154, peaking at 0.11440 at 72,000 dots.

irregularities.finding: Target leakage in static d2.8 holdout benchmark: d2.8 (gems24-h25-1-dotted-h19-5-d2-8, 44,090 dots) was derived from H19-5, which was trained on the FULL labels.tif (including fold.withheld of gems85-holdout-v1.0.0) and zeroed d=0 while leaving 6,436 dots at d=1..2 px around labels.tif (3.03x density lift vs 1.23x on off-catalogue SGMC faults). Deleting d=1 px (h27-4) drops d2.8's holdout tp_w from 9,498.8 to 2,804.3 (DTI 0.11818 -> 0.03560), and deleting d<=2 px (h33-2-b2) drops tp_w by 96.0% to 378.0 (DTI 0.00485), while the live score rises 0.2600 -> 0.2708 -> 0.2778.
irregularities.action_taken: Documented the exact 3-step decomposition in evidence/experiments.json and README.md. Even against this leaked 0.11153 static benchmark, our zero-leakage fold-proper H85-S6-2 detector achieves HOLDOUT-DTI 0.11440 at 72,000 dots and 0.11309 at 60,000 dots.
